title: Stabilize marketing + admin views and ensure frontend build reliability

requirements.summary: Fix runtime errors and broken navigation/scrolling across Home and Admin views for reliable end-to-end usage.
acceptanceCriteria: Loading the site shows the Home view without uncaught exceptions in the browser console.
Header navigation links scroll to the correct sections (Hero/Services/About/Contact) on the Home view.
Switching to the Admin view via hash route (/#/admin) renders the AdminPage without runtime errors and can return back to Home view.
No broken links or obviously broken UI states are present during normal navigation.

file_operations.description: Harden hash-route handling for switching between home and admin (normalize hashes like '#/admin', '#/admin/', and unknown hashes) and ensure view switching never throws during navigation.
Ensure Home view always has safe SiteContent data (including before the actor is ready) by adjusting query enablement/fallback behavior to prevent undefined content and reduce console/runtime errors.

Stabilize section scrolling behavior (e.g., guard against missing targets and close mobile sheet consistently) so Hero/Services/About/Contact navigation scrolls reliably. Verify the component's usage instructions before implementing.

Fix Quick Links section scrolling so 'Home' scrolls to the Hero section (id 'hero') rather than a non-existent 'home' id, and ensure other links match existing section ids. Verify the component's usage instructions before implementing.

requirements.summary: Resolve frontend build/config issues so the project builds and deploys successfully and core flows work on the deployed site.
acceptanceCriteria: A full project build completes without errors.
A deployment completes successfully and the deployed site loads in a browser.
Core flows function on the deployed site: Home view renders, Contact form is interactive (when actor is ready), and Admin view route loads.

file_operations.description: Fix TypeScript/React typing issues that can break the production build (e.g., remove reliance on the global React namespace for types) while keeping the UI behavior unchanged. Verify the component's usage instructions before implementing.

Fix TypeScript typing usage for form event handling (avoid 'React.FormEvent' without importing the React type) to prevent build failures, keeping form UX unchanged. Verify the component's usage instructions before implementing.
Eliminate build-breaking lint/TypeScript issues (such as unused imports) and improve error visibility for inquiry creation without changing backend interactions.
